The most serious crime is depraved-heart murder, because shooting a gun at a person’s leg in a crowded basketball game shows reckless indifference to an unjustifiably high risk to human life, and the transferred intent doctrine applies the same malice to the unintended killing. It is not premeditated murder because he intended only a slight wound, and felony murder would require an inherently dangerous felony such as mayhem or assault with a deadly weapon, which may also support murder but is not necessary here.
